title: Pregnant Duo #18
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Lebanese, in her early 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a professional female bodybuilder physique, carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps, wide flaring lats, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep — and projecting forward from her hard, muscular middle, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its surface taut and round even where the muscle around it stays hard and defined. Diamond-shaped calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, sleek silver-grey hair styled in elegant updo, real pores, real living eyes, 8 bars piercings set with sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver an anklet. Painted in French Limoges enamel, a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of grisaille scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her mid 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real pores, real living eyes, 25 clicker rings piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver a bracelet. Painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work, a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold-and-crimson bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of jewel-toned scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme gold-and-crimson extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
